description: Amazon Research ST: amazon/product Query API.

marketplace.description: Amazon site codes: `us`, `gb`, `de`, `fr`, `in`, `ca`, `jp`, `es`, `it`, `mx`, `ae`, `au`, `br`, `sa`. UK uses `gb`. AU, BR, and IN do not support historical review.

page.description: Page numbers; maximum 100 products per page, maximum 200 pages.

queryMode.description: Query method: `1` single condition, `2` multi-condition combination (AND).

queryMonth.description: Historical snapshot month, format `yyyy-MM`; query real-time data if not specified, supported from 2024-01.

queryType.description: Single condition query type, range 1-16; invalid when `queryMode=2`. See table below.

queryValue.description: Query value, the format is determined by `queryType`; when `queryMode=2`, the JSON condition array string is passed in.
